title: RBI Tightens Governance Norms for Urban & Rural Co-operative Banks
summary: RBI mandates a 3-year cooling-off period for directors completing 10 years of continuous tenure on the board of UCBs and RCBs.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Tightens Governance Norms for Urban & Rural Co-operative Banks. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI issued immediate governance directions requiring a **3-year cooling-off period** for directors completing 10 continuous years on UCB/RCB boards under Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
